challenges.title: NCLEX-RN challenge 1 (timed)
challenges.description: Timed (2 h 50 min). 85 items weighted like the NCLEX-RN test plan, including 2 case studies. Exam rules: no going back, answers and a pass estimate at the end. Replaced by the adaptive exam.
